notes.title: Bogatyr Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36016202/b847d3c26749e682fbc81a284bffb1c5d441fe67.jpg[/img]Fellow gamers,
It may sound like a surprise for you, but the bratans team is still making the Bogatyr game better and better, trying to fix most of the issues our community pointed at. Here you may see bugs fixed and features added recently:
- Map Legend has been updated (inteface is now not button-like)
- Cutscenes now skip automaticly.
- Game Objects (enemies, quest characters, animals) Navigation agents have been changed - now they cannot be moved by player.
- After Unequip action main strike ability UI now returns to default image.
- Sounds and Music Setting now work properly (sounds slider is active and volume level works better overall)
- Main Menu has been remastered
- New grass and flowers textures has been added
- Pig special attack has been fixed partially, sound of pig is less annoying now and pig has lifetime now;
- Characters like Egor & Oleg or Priest now starts game in new positions after their quests are completed (Only after LoadGame button)
- Quest Log visual has been updated (quest names and quest descriptions now differs from each other more)

notes.title: Hotfix #2
notes.notes:
We are glad to present one more hotfix for you. Here is what has changed in the Bogatyr the game:
1) Bogatyr Soundtrack is now available on Steam!!! Check it out.
2) Localization improvements - Mongol Scout, Farmer and Priest are now properly localized in English.
3) You now get experience when killing enemies with abilities.
4) Special Attack damages is now scaled to weapon type. Is reduced to Birch Wood peace and is higher for Poleaxe, mace and sword.
4) Most of achievements are now fixed.
5) Sand footsteps sound is now fixed .

notes.title: Bogatyr Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Good day to you, fellow players!
the Bratans team have carefully read your comments and we are making our best to make Bogatyr better.
Due to our main and only programmer being in Iraq at the release date it took some time for us to fix main issues and bugs. We yet have many to fox but we are happy to announce our first patch:

1) Dialogs. Many user complaint about localization. We have fixed all cases reported to us (please write us about every issue)

2) Optimization. We also dealt with problem with labs while walking and game crashes (problem was into fps max rate at 60). If any of fellow players still have that issue - please report. This fix may affect central processor load, but not critically.

3) FPS. We made additional efforts to make FPS in game higher and decrease number of lags cases.

4) Local forester, quest character, is now fixed.
